statement: WITH tx AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) et, CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) amount, CAST(balance AS DOUBLE) balance FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/transactions.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true) UNION ALL SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT), CAST(amount AS DOUBLE), CAST(balance AS DOUBLE) FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/transactions_late.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)) SELECT 'expected_tx' AS src, et, amount, balance FROM tx WHERE account_id='A0000' AND et <= 1773055706000 ORDER BY et DESC LIMIT 3
